description: Start each new thread on the connected machine with the most free CPU and memory, without picking one yourself. The new-thread screen moves to the best machine for the project, and a machine you pick by hand stays picked until you send. A Machines settings section shows each machine's live load and score, and lets you set a machine to Prefer, Normal, Less often or Manual only. Agents get a bb balance command to spawn child threads on the least-busy machine. Needs BB 0.50 or newer and at least two connected machines to have an effect. Nothing leaves your machines.
